_meta.principle: The aesthetic preset goes at the END of the prompt as a styling layer. It composes with the camera move + action prompt fragments. Picking the wrong aesthetic for the channel is the #1 failure mode (we picked 'premium' for Puck v3, which is a brand-video aesthetic, not a social-ad aesthetic).
_meta.decision_rule: If the destination is a paid social feed (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts), pick UGC or lifestyle. If the destination is a brand keynote, product page, or B2B channel, pick premium or cinematic. Brand videos play in showrooms — social ads play next to UGC of someone's lunch.

ugc.name: UGC handheld (highest social conversion per 2026 neuroscience)
ugc.use: Reels / TikTok / YouTube Shorts. Default for any social ad target.
ugc.fragment: shot on iPhone, handheld with slight natural motion, vertical 9:16, casual lighting, organic feel, NOT polished or cinematic, NOT professional studio, slightly imperfect framing
ugc.lighting: available natural light or single-source warm light, not studio-lit
ugc.motion_advice: use handheld_documentary, first_person_pov, follow_behind camera moves
ugc.post_advice: minimal color grading, leave slight noise, do NOT upscale to perfect

ugc_street_interview.name: UGC street interview (organic vox-pop format)
ugc_street_interview.use: Reels / TikTok — talking-to-camera in a real environment. Sub-pattern of ugc. Best fit: TS (founder counter-culture voice on the street), RH (wearer approached interview-style). Simulates organic street content, not an ad.
ugc_street_interview.fragment: street interview style, handheld phone camera with slight instability, subject speaking directly to lens while walking or standing in a casual urban environment, interviewer implied just off-frame, ambient street background, vertical 9:16, organic feel, NOT studio, NOT polished, NOT tripod-stable
ugc_street_interview.lighting: available daylight or storefront/street lighting, mixed color temperatures acceptable
ugc_street_interview.motion_advice: use handheld_documentary, over_the_shoulder, follow_behind camera moves
ugc_street_interview.post_advice: minimal grade, leave noise and micro-shake, do NOT stabilize to gimbal-smooth
ugc_street_interview.source: DYzXTE-scCu / byjoeym (June 2026 IG absorb) — native feed rule: copy organic formats

ugc_try_on.name: UGC try-on (mirror / bedroom haul format)
ugc_try_on.use: Reels / TikTok — person tries on the item with a natural unscripted reaction. Sub-pattern of ugc. Best fit: RH, TS (wearables). NOT applicable to DD (non-wearable EDC). No product packaging visible in frame.
ugc_try_on.fragment: casual try-on video, bedroom or mirror setting, person puts on the garment and reacts naturally, phone propped or handheld at eye level, lived-in room visible in background, vertical 9:16, unscripted feel, NOT studio, NOT staged product packaging, NOT professional model posing
ugc_try_on.feel: Haul / fit-check — a friend showing you what they bought
ugc_try_on.lighting: single warm room light or window daylight, not studio-lit
ugc_try_on.motion_advice: use eye_level_static (propped phone) or handheld_documentary; rack_focus for fabric detail
ugc_try_on.post_advice: minimal color grade, keep mirror/phone realism, do NOT upscale to perfect
ugc_try_on.source: DYzXTE-scCu / byjoeym (June 2026 IG absorb) — native feed rule: copy organic formats

lifestyle.name: Lifestyle (commercial-grade UGC)
lifestyle.use: Mid-tier social — DTC product ads where you want polish without losing authenticity
lifestyle.fragment: natural daylight, lived-in environment, soft shadows, color graded for warmth, slight cinematic depth, real-world setting
lifestyle.feel: Professional-but-relatable, like a magazine spread that moves
lifestyle.lighting: soft natural daylight, golden hour preferred, avoid studio rim lights
lifestyle.post_advice: subtle color grade, light Topaz upscale OK, keep some grain

cinematic.name: Cinematic (movie-quality, broad-audience)
cinematic.use: Hero brand videos, launch trailers, premium DTC. NOT default for social.
cinematic.fragment: cinematic 35mm film aesthetic, anamorphic letterbox feel, dramatic key + rim lighting, deep shadows, color graded teal-and-orange or moody monochrome, depth of field with shallow focus
cinematic.feel: Hollywood-trailer language — anamorphic feel, dramatic lighting, scored music
cinematic.lighting: dramatic three-point lighting, hard key + soft fill + rim, deep shadows OK
cinematic.post_advice: heavy color grading, Topaz upscale to 4K, frame interpolation for slo-mo

premium_product.name: Premium product photography (Apple-keynote vibe)
premium_product.use: Brand pages, premium product detail pages, B2B keynotes. Brand videos NOT social ads.
premium_product.fragment: premium product photography aesthetic, locked camera no movement, slow deliberate reveal, clean studio lighting from upper-left, deep dramatic shadows on dark background, hyperrealistic, 8k product render quality, NOT handheld NOT casual
premium_product.feel: Apple keynote — locked camera, slow reveals, clinical lighting, silent except for product sound design
premium_product.lighting: studio softbox upper-left, deep negative fill on right, accent rim light
premium_product.motion_advice: use static (eye_level_static, low_angle_power, extreme_close_up) or very slow push_in
premium_product.post_advice: minimal color grade (already lit), 4K upscale, ensure pixel-perfect product fidelity
premium_product.warning: This is what we did for Puck v3 — and per neuroscience research it converts WORSE on social than UGC. Reserve for brand pages and keynotes, not feed-targeted ads.

documentary.name: Documentary (real, raw, observational)
documentary.use: Founder-story ads, behind-the-scenes content, transparency-driven brands
documentary.fragment: documentary style cinematography, observational camera, slight handheld, available light, grain visible, no obvious lighting setup, candid feel
documentary.feel: Vice / Magnolia Network — observational, slightly distant, grain visible
documentary.lighting: available light only, accept whatever's in the scene
documentary.post_advice: leave grain, minimal color grade, almost no visual polish

kinetic_typography.name: Kinetic typography (text-led, no live action)
kinetic_typography.use: Quote / stat / announcement reels. Pure text + motion.
kinetic_typography.fragment: kinetic typography animation, bold text reveals, brand color palette, text scale and rotation animations, minimal background, vertical 9:16
kinetic_typography.feel: Modern brand-poster motion — words build, punctuate, exit
kinetic_typography.motion_advice: n/a — built in Remotion not generated, use this preset for the brief that goes to Remotion

anime_stylized.name: Anime / illustrated (stylized non-real)
anime_stylized.use: Any brand with an illustrated identity. Avoids uncanny valley entirely.
anime_stylized.fragment: anime style illustration, hand-drawn aesthetic, bold flat colors, dynamic composition, NOT photorealistic, stylized characters
anime_stylized.feel: Studio Ghibli / Spider-Verse — clearly illustrated, avoids uncanny
anime_stylized.lighting: stylized illustrated lighting, no real-world physics required
anime_stylized.motion_advice: use any — illustrated style hides AI motion artifacts
anime_stylized.post_advice: minimal — keep the illustrated look intact

raw_street.name: Raw street / underground (counter-culture brands)
raw_street.fragment: raw street style, urban environment, gritty texture, fluorescent or sodium lighting, slight underexposure, dynamic handheld energy, anti-corporate aesthetic
raw_street.feel: Skate video, warehouse documentary, unfiltered urban
raw_street.lighting: fluorescent / sodium / streetlight — embrace mixed temperatures
raw_street.motion_advice: use whip_pan, handheld_documentary, fast crash zooms
raw_street.post_advice: high contrast, push the shadows, leave noise
